name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, volunteering at a local rally event after a career change from engineering. The raw energy and mechanical ingenuity ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She honed her skills at a smaller racing outfit before joining Andretti Global, where her methodical approach to fabrication quickly earned her a reputation for precision and reliability.

Eleanor is particularly adept at metal fabrication and welding, often taking the lead on complex chassis modifications and component repairs. She believes in thorough planning and meticulous execution, ensuring that every part meets the highest standards of performance and safety. Her colleagues value her calm demeanor under pressure and her willingness to share her knowledge.

What sets Eleanor apart is her ability to diagnose problems quickly and devise practical solutions. She is always thinking several steps ahead, anticipating potential issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. Her loyalty to the team and dedication to her craft make her an invaluable asset to Andretti Global.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor has a practical, no-nonsense appearance, with kind eyes and a smattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting a new task.
Has a small collection of vintage motorsport posters displayed in her workspace.
Prefers to listen to classical music while working, claiming it helps her focus.
